rubric.0: No source evidence answering the actual question. Topic overlap or a matching company name alone is insufficient.
rubric.1: A passage establishes an explicit component of the requested fact, but not the complete answer.
rubric.2: A passage directly establishes the requested fact, company/package, version, and time constraint.
rubric.policy: Strict evidence relevance. A release event is not a commit-growth series, a hiring event, funding, or an evidence-ledger policy.
rubric.release_study: Known-release fact lookup; only the specifically requested release is relevant, even if other releases share changes.

ranking_unit: Unique record IDs in citation order; not raw retriever candidates.
